column1: # Brimhaven Agility Arena (Wiki "Brimhaven Agility Arena"). Generated from the cache map (squares 42-44 x 149-150,
# arena plane 3, floor plane 0): 25 pillars on an 11-tile grid, x 2761..2805, z 9546..9590 (2805,9590 is the ladder).
# Coords are x,z,plane. Landing tiles are the platform tile next to the next pillar; fall tiles are the obstacle middle
# on the floor below. All guessed from geometry; confirm in game.
# climb     <loc> <loc tile> <dest>                      (floor ropes back up onto a pillar)
# dispenser <loc> <loc tile>                             (ticket dispensers, one active at a time)
# trap      <kind> <loc tile> <x,z;x,z...>               (walk-over traps; tiles projected onto the walkway)
